capabilities: Expose vault file CRUD, patching, and active-file operations as MCP tools
Search the vault with Dataview, full-text, and semantic queries
Execute Templater templates and auto-discovered MCP prompts
Fetch web pages and convert HTML to Markdown
Install and configure the MCP server from a settings UI
disambiguation: Not a REST API server itself; it wraps the existing obsidian-local-rest-api to expose the vault over the Model Context Protocol.
extras: Requires Node.js >= 20; README states the server communicates only with the local REST API (127.0.0.1:27124) and its fetch tool makes outbound requests only when invoked. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: built as a thin wrapper over the Obsidian REST API
problem: AI assistants have no built-in way to read, edit, or search files in an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: built as a thin wrapper over the Obsidian REST API
execute_template — run Templater templates with arguments

requires.name: MCP client such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop

summary: MCP server and Obsidian plugin that exposes vault CRUD, search, Templater execution, and web fetch as tools for AI assistants over the local REST API.
